summary: Practise digital lesson design, classroom assessment, LMS delivery, and school recordkeeping. Explore ICT tools for education and enrol today.
lede: ICT integration in education helps teachers and school staff use digital tools to prepare lessons, deliver learning, assess progress and maintain records. The training is for classroom teachers, digital learning coordinators, school administrators and education officers who manage these everyday tasks. Participants practise creating Word and PowerPoint resources, Forms quizzes and Excel trackers, building a Moodle learning sequence, and reviewing lesson tasks and materials for accessibility.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for education professionals who create lessons, deliver learning, maintain school information, or support digital teaching practice. It suits those who need practical skills with common productivity software and classroom technology.
modules: Digital Administration and School Action Plan
prerequisites: Basic ability to operate a computer, manage files, and use a web browser. No coding or programming is required. For hands-on tasks, you should have access to a laptop and the productivity software or LMS available in your work setting.
